name: AboutDialog
desc: The application's introduction dialog, which can specify the application icon, application name, application version number, and other information, as well as the internal sub-component list. Clicking the button on the left can navigate to the certificate page.

fields.name: applicationVersion
fields.desc: The version of this build of the application.

fields.name: applicationIcon
fields.desc: The icon to show next to the application name.

fields.name: applicationLegalese
fields.desc: A string to show in small print.

fields.name: children
fields.desc: Widgets to add to the dialog box after the name, version, and legalese.
